name: com.innov8tif.okaycam.selfie.OkayCamSelfie
description: When an app requests regular selfie capture, OkayCam (Innov8tif) opens the front camera so the user can take a photo. It then shows the image for confirmation or retaking.
disableEffect: The app cannot complete this OkayCam selfie flow or receive its photo if this screen is disabled.
